description: mla_prefill_varlen that also returns each query's log-sum-exp, the passes of a chunked prefix that sglang merges: sequence s's queries are q's rows cu_seqlens_q[s]:cu_seqlens_q[s + 1], its keys and values the rows cu_seqlens_k[s]:cu_seqlens_k[s + 1] of k and v (with no prefix, the queries' own rows). With causal, aligned at the end: query i of a sequence of Lq queries over Lk keys reads keys 0 .. Lk - Lq + i; without, every key of its sequence (a prefix chunk, each of whose keys precedes every query). Logits q . k * sm_scale over qk_head_dim; output the softmax-weighted sum of v, lse the natural log of the sum of exp(logit) over the keys read, per query row and head. With qkv_fp8 a kernel may round q, k and v to float8_e4m3fn first, as aiter's fp8 prefill does.

n_q.description: Query rows, every sequence's back to back.

n_kv.description: Key and value rows, every sequence's back to back.

n_heads.description: Heads on this rank; k and v carry q's.

qk_head_dim.description: Values per q and k head: the no-rope and rope parts.

v_head_dim.description: Values per v and output head.

cu_seqlens_q.description: Where each sequence's queries start in q, then where the last ends.

output.description: The softmax-weighted sum of the values each query reads.

lse.description: Natural log-sum-exp of the scaled logits each query reads, [query row, head].

"""Host side of the kernel's per-shape plan, apart from the GPU code so that it moves to any revision of kernel.py:
aiter's persistent plan with need_lse for one sequence, its CU lists permuted onto XCD pairs (``_d1a``), built with
numpy and copied to the device in one non-blocking copy from pinned memory, so that a plan never waits on the GPU."""

import functools

import numpy as np
import torch

N_HEADS = 12
N_CU = 256
TILE_Q = 256
KV_GRANULARITY = 128
XCDS = 8
# int32 elements between the starts of the arrays in one upload: 16-byte aligned for the ASM and FlyDSL kernels
_ALIGN = 4
# piece plans kept on the host: a forward's layers share one, and serving sees new lengths without end
PIECES_KEPT = 512


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=PIECES_KEPT)
def piece_plan_host(n_q, n_kv, causal):
    """(work_indptr, work_info as rows of 8, tiles, n_partial): what ``_piece_plan`` builds before its copies, with
    the CU lists permuted as ``_d1a`` does (each 3-head cluster on two XCDs) when every CU has work."""
    from .ps_plan import walk_plan

    walk, clusters, heads, tiles = walk_plan(
        [0, n_q], [0, n_kv], [n_kv], N_HEADS, num_cus=N_CU, qlen_granularity=TILE_Q,
        kvlen_granularity=KV_GRANULARITY, block_size=1, is_causal=causal,
    )  # fmt: skip
    tgs = len(walk)
    # one block of works per CU: the walk of its CU index within the cluster, once per head of the cluster
    rows = [np.asarray(mine, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1, 7) for mine in walk]
    order = [(c, tg) for c in range(clusters) for tg in range(tgs)]
    # _d1a: CU l of cluster c, its i-th, goes to (i // 2) * 8 + 2 * c + i % 2, when there are 256 CUs in 4
    # clusters of 64 and none is without work
    if N_CU == 256 and clusters == 4 and tgs == 64 and all(len(r) for r in rows):
        order = [(p % XCDS // 2, 2 * (p // XCDS) + p % XCDS % 2) for p in range(N_CU)]
    lens = np.asarray([len(rows[tg]) for _, tg in order], dtype=np.int64)
    counts = np.zeros(len(order) + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    np.cumsum(heads * lens, out=counts[1:])
    if counts[-1] == 0:
        return counts.astype(np.int32), np.empty((0, 8), dtype=np.int32), tiles, max(r for _, _, part in tiles for r in part) + TILE_Q
    stacked = [np.tile(r, (heads, 1)) for r in rows]
    work_info = np.empty((int(counts[-1]), 8), dtype=np.int64)
    work_info[:, :7] = np.concatenate([stacked[tg] for _, tg in order])
    head = np.repeat(np.asarray([c for c, _ in order]) * heads, heads) + np.tile(np.arange(heads), len(order))
    work_info[:, 7] = np.repeat(((head + 1) << 16) | (head & 0xFFFF), np.repeat(lens, heads))
    n_partial = max(r for _, _, part in tiles for r in part) + TILE_Q
    return counts.astype(np.int32), work_info.astype(np.int32), tiles, n_partial


def upload(arrays, device):
    """The int32 host arrays as device tensors, in one copy from pinned memory in stream order that returns at once:
    the pinned block is reused only after the copy has read it (torch's caching host allocator records it)."""
    sizes = [int(np.prod(a.shape)) for a in arrays]
    starts = np.cumsum([0] + [-(-n // _ALIGN) * _ALIGN for n in sizes])
    host = torch.empty(int(starts[-1]), dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True)
    flat = host.numpy()
    for a, s, n in zip(arrays, starts, sizes):
        flat[s : s + n] = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.int32).reshape(-1)
    dev = host.to(device, non_blocking=True)
    return [dev[s : s + n].view(a.shape) for a, s, n in zip(arrays, starts, sizes)]


# Most keys one ASM call reads (kernel.py's KV_SEGMENT)
KV_SEGMENT = 65536
# The reduce's unroll depths: a plan's deepest split rounds up to one of these (about 1.25 x apart), so that the
# reduce kernels a server can need are few enough to compile all at warmup. A tile pads its partials to the depth with
# its first, weighted 0 (lse -inf): exp2(-inf) adds 0 to the weight sum and 0 x a finite partial to each accumulator,
# so the output and lse are bit for bit those of the exact depth.
REDUCE_SPLITS = (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 112, 128, 160, 192,
                 224, 256, 320, 384, 448, 512, 640, 768, 896, 1024)  # fmt: skip
_DEEPER = 256  # past the last depth: a multiple of this


# deeper reduces take no shorter unroll: plans that deep split their tiles evenly
_SHORT_UPTO = 128


def _shorts(depth):
    """The shorter unrolls a reduce of ``depth`` may take: depths at least half of it, up to _SHORT_UPTO."""
    return [s for s in REDUCE_SPLITS if depth / 2 <= s < depth] if depth <= _SHORT_UPTO else []


def reduce_depth(max_splits, counts):
    """``(depth, short)``: the deepest split rounded up to a depth of REDUCE_SPLITS, and the shorter unroll for tiles
    split at most that deep, among ``_shorts(depth)``, that minimises the loads summed over tiles, when it saves at
    least 15 % of them (else 0)."""
    depth = next((d for d in REDUCE_SPLITS if d >= max_splits), -(-max_splits // _DEEPER) * _DEEPER)
    cost = lambda sh: sum(sh if n <= sh else depth for n in counts) if sh else depth * len(counts)  # noqa: E731
    short = min(_shorts(depth), key=lambda sh: (cost(sh), sh), default=0)
    return depth, (short if short and cost(short) <= 0.85 * cost(0) else 0)


def reduce_variants(max_depth=REDUCE_SPLITS[-1]):
    """Every ``(depth, short)`` a plan of at most ``max_depth`` splits can ask the reduce for."""
    return [(d, s) for d in REDUCE_SPLITS if d <= max_depth for s in [0, *_shorts(d)]]


def plan_host(n_q, n_kv, causal, piece=None):
    """What ``_plan`` decides on the host for one sequence: ``(calls, n_partial, desc, n_tiles, depth, short)``,
    each call ``(q0, q1, k0, k1, piece_causal, base, piece_partial)`` (its piece plan is ``piece(q1 - q0, k1 - k0,
    piece_causal)``), desc the reduce's descriptor rows, flat int32."""
    piece = piece or piece_plan_host
    if causal:
        prefix = n_kv - n_q
        pieces = [(0, n_q, i, min(i + KV_SEGMENT, prefix), False) for i in range(0, prefix, KV_SEGMENT)]
        for j in range(0, n_q, KV_SEGMENT):
            q_end = min(j + KV_SEGMENT, n_q)
            pieces += [(j, q_end, prefix + i, prefix + i + KV_SEGMENT, False) for i in range(0, j, KV_SEGMENT)]
            pieces.append((j, q_end, prefix + j, prefix + q_end, True))
    else:
        pieces = [(0, n_q, i, min(i + KV_SEGMENT, n_kv), False) for i in range(0, n_kv, KV_SEGMENT)]
    calls, groups, base = [], {}, 0
    for q0, q1, k0, k1, piece_causal in pieces:
        _, _, tiles, n_partial = piece(q1 - q0, k1 - k0, piece_causal)
        for q_start, q_end, rows in tiles:
            groups.setdefault((q0 + q_start, q0 + q_end), []).extend(base + r for r in rows)
        calls.append((q0, q1, k0, k1, piece_causal, base, n_partial))
        base += n_partial
    spans = sorted(groups)
    # every query row reduced exactly once
    assert spans[0][0] == 0 and spans[-1][1] == n_q and all(a[1] == b[0] for a, b in zip(spans, spans[1:]))
    counts = [len(groups[span]) for span in spans]
    depth, short = reduce_depth(max(counts), counts)
    desc = []
    for q_start, q_end in spans:
        ps = [r * N_HEADS for r in groups[(q_start, q_end)]]
        ps += [ps[0]] * (depth - len(ps))
        desc += [q_start * N_HEADS, (q_end - q_start) * N_HEADS, len(groups[(q_start, q_end)])] + ps
    return calls, base, np.asarray(desc, dtype=np.int32), len(spans), depth, short

"""MLA prefill attention that also returns each query's log-sum-exp (sglang's chunked-prefix passes: the causal pass
over the extend tokens, and the pass over a prefix chunk that every query reads whole; causal over a prefix too), in
fp8: q, k and v are rounded to float8_e4m3fn (one FlyDSL launch for all three) and aiter's persistent ASM prefill
runs at the native 12 heads, causal or not, on a persistent work plan built here once per shape (``ps_plan.py``; a
single sequence's offsets are fixed by the row counts), so that every query tile, split or not, leaves fp32 partials
with their log-sum-exp, and each 3-head cluster sits on two XCDs. A causal call with as many queries as keys takes a
cost-model plan: at the query counts in FILL_PLAN_N a capacity plan (each tile longer than the smallest CU capacity
that packs is cut once into a piece of that capacity and the rest, and the pieces are packed best fit, longest first),
otherwise each tile's keys cut evenly into pieces, placed longest first on the least-loaded CU, the piece length
chosen to minimise the predicted makespan; any other piece takes the plan aiter's planner builds with
need_lse, its CU lists permuted. No ASM call reads more than 65536 keys: a longer key range is cut
into segments, each its own call (causal: the prefix before the queries' own keys in segments read whole, then each
65536-query block reads its own keys' segments before it whole and its own causally). A FlyDSL kernel merges each
query tile's partials, from every segment, in a fixed order into the output and writes the tile's natural-log lse.
One sequence: dispatch serves only the sequence count the workloads measure."""

import functools
import math

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import numpy as np
import torch
from flydsl.expr import gpu, rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import T

from .host_plan import reduce_depth, reduce_variants, upload

N_HEADS = 12
QK_DIM = 192
V_DIM = 128
TILE_Q = 256  # the plan's query tile
N_CU = 256

# --- FlyDSL map reduce. Each query tile s has a descriptor row [out_base, n_rows, n_splits, p_0 .. p_{MS-1}] with
# out_base = q_start * H, n_rows = (q_end - q_start) * H and p_j = partial row j * H (padded with p_0). Row x of the
# tile (x = local_q * H + h) merges partial rows p_j + x by their natural-log lse, in j order, into out_base + x, and
# writes the merged lse, max + ln(sum of exp(lse_j - max)), to lse row out_base + x.
_LOG2E = math.log2(math.e)
_LN2 = math.log(2.0)
VEC = 4  # fp32 values per lane: one 16-byte load
LANES_PER_ROW = V_DIM // VEC
NUM_THREADS = 256
ROWS_PER_BLOCK = NUM_THREADS // LANES_PER_ROW
DESC_HEAD = 3
# row groups of ROWS_PER_BLOCK rows each workgroup merges, all their loads issued before any merge (divides
# TILE_Q * N_HEADS // ROWS_PER_BLOCK): 2 takes the reduce 0.5 us under 1 at 3072 queries and 2.5 us at 15360
REDUCE_ROW_GROUPS = 2
# deepest split that merges REDUCE_ROW_GROUPS groups a workgroup: each group's partials are held at once, so the
# scratch of a deep merge doubles (depth 448 failed to launch with 8 GiB free); deeper splits merge one group a
# workgroup, each row's result the same
REDUCE_ROW_GROUPS_MAX_SPLITS = 16


def _row_groups(max_splits: int) -> int:
    return REDUCE_ROW_GROUPS if max_splits <= REDUCE_ROW_GROUPS_MAX_SPLITS else 1


def _view(ptr, dtype, shape, stride):
    return fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(fx.make_view(fx.recast_iter(dtype, ptr), fx.make_layout(shape, stride)))


@functools.cache
def compile_reduce(max_splits: int, short_splits: int = 0, row_groups: int = 1):
    """Tiles with at most short_splits splits take an unroll of that depth, the others one of max_splits."""
    MS = max_splits
    ROW_GROUPS = row_groups
    STRIDE = DESC_HEAD + MS

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[NUM_THREADS, 1, 1])
    def reduce_kernel(
        part: fx.Pointer,  # f32 [P, V_DIM] (P = partial rows * H)
        lse: fx.Pointer,  # f32 [P]
        desc: fx.Pointer,  # i32 [n_tiles, STRIDE]
        out: fx.Pointer,  # bf16 [R, V_DIM]
        out_lse: fx.Pointer,  # f32 [R]
        n_part: fx.Int32,
        n_out: fx.Int32,
        n_tiles: fx.Int32,
    ):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bx = fx.block_idx.x
        by = fx.block_idx.y
        c_lanes = fx.Int32(LANES_PER_ROW)
        x = bx * fx.Int32(ROWS_PER_BLOCK * ROW_GROUPS) + tid // c_lanes
        lane = tid % c_lanes

        g_desc = _view(desc, fx.Int32, (n_tiles * fx.Int32(STRIDE),), (1,))
        g_part = _view(part, fx.Float32, (n_part, V_DIM), (V_DIM, 1))
        g_lse = _view(lse, fx.Float32, (n_part,), (1,))
        g_out = _view(out, fx.BFloat16, (n_out, V_DIM), (V_DIM, 1))
        r_lse = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(out_lse, n_out * fx.Int32(4)))

        base = by * fx.Int32(STRIDE)
        out_base = g_desc[base]
        n_rows = g_desc[base + fx.Int32(1)]
        n_splits = g_desc[base + fx.Int32(2)]
        last = n_rows - fx.Int32(1)

        reg_layout = fx.make_layout(VEC, 1)
        atom = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(), fx.Float32)
        neg_inf = fx.Float32(float("-inf"))

        def body(ms):
            # every row group's loads first, then each one's merge and store
            p_rows = [g_desc[base + fx.Int32(DESC_HEAD + j)] for j in range(ms)]
            loaded = []
            for u in fx.range_constexpr(ROW_GROUPS):
                xu = x + fx.Int32(u * ROWS_PER_BLOCK)
                # a row past the tile reads the tile's last (in bounds) and stores nothing
                act = xu <= last
                xu = (xu > last).select(last, xu)
                lses = []
                parts = []
                for j in fx.range_constexpr(ms):
                    prow = p_rows[j] + xu
                    l = g_lse[prow]
                    if j >= 1:  # an unsplit tile pads its one partial: weigh the copies 0
                        l = (fx.Int32(j) < n_splits).select(l, neg_inf)
                    lses.append(l)
                    tiled = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(g_part, (prow, None)), reg_layout)
                    frag = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_layout, fx.Float32)
                    fx.copy_atom_call(atom, fx.slice(tiled, (None, lane)), frag)
                    parts.append(frag.load())
                loaded.append((xu, act, lses, parts))

            for xu, act, lses, parts in loaded:
                m = lses[0]
                for j in fx.range_constexpr(1, ms):
                    m = m.maximumf(lses[j])
                zero = fx.Float32(0.0)
                finite = m > neg_inf
                m = finite.select(m, zero)

                acc = [zero for _ in fx.range_constexpr(VEC)]
                den = zero
                for j in fx.range_constexpr(ms):
                    w = fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.exp2(T.f32, ((lses[j] - m) * _LOG2E).ir_value()))
                    den = den + w
                    v = parts[j]
                    acc = [acc[i] + w * v[i] for i in fx.range_constexpr(VEC)]
                inv = fx.Float32((den > zero).select(fx.rocdl.rcp(T.f32, den.ir_value()), zero))

                res = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_layout, fx.BFloat16)
                res.store(fx.Vector.from_elements([(acc[i] * inv).to(fx.BFloat16) for i in fx.range_constexpr(VEC)],
                                                  dtype=fx.BFloat16))
                out_atom = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy64b(), fx.BFloat16)
                out_tiled = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(g_out, (out_base + xu, None)), reg_layout)
                # log2(0) = -inf leaves a row that read no key at -inf
                row_lse = m + fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.log(T.f32, den.ir_value())) * _LN2
                if act:
                    fx.copy_atom_call(out_atom, res, fx.slice(out_tiled, (None, lane)))
                    # the row's first lane stores its lse
                    if lane == fx.Int32(0):
                        rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(
                            row_lse.ir_value(), r_lse, ((out_base + xu) * fx.Int32(4)).ir_value(),
                            fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
                        )

        if 0 < short_splits < MS:
            if n_splits <= fx.Int32(short_splits):
                body(short_splits)
            else:
                body(MS)
        else:
            body(MS)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        part: fx.Pointer,
        lse: fx.Pointer,
        desc: fx.Pointer,
        out: fx.Pointer,
        out_lse: fx.Pointer,
        n_part: fx.Int32,
        n_out: fx.Int32,
        n_tiles: fx.Int32,
        n_blocks: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream = fx.Stream(None),
    ):
        reduce_kernel(part, lse, desc, out, out_lse, n_part, n_out, n_tiles).launch(
            grid=(n_blocks, n_tiles, 1), block=(NUM_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch

# --- FlyDSL fused bf16 -> fp8 e4m3fn cast of q, k and v in one launch. Each tensor is a flat run of 8-element rows;
# block b owns unroll x 256 consecutive rows of one tensor (the blocks of q come first, then k, then v), each
# lane one 16-byte nontemporal bf16 load and one 8-byte fp8 store per step. The buffers' sizes bound the tails.
CAST_THREADS = 256
CAST_VEC = 8
# Rows per lane, and the loads' cache policy: the bf16 inputs are read once, so they load nontemporal (slc) and leave
# the caches to the fp8 outputs the ASM reads next; the stores keep the default policy (nontemporal stores make the
# cast alone 19 % faster on 893/35107 but the ASM slower by more). Measured on cast + ASM + reduce in CUDA graphs:
# nontemporal loads at unroll 2 against default loads at unroll 1-2: 893/35107 -1.2 %, 2732/35107 -0.6 %,
# 2732/104093 -1.8 %, 9397/104093 -0.5 %, 16384/65536 -0.5 %, 16384/131072 -0.4 %; unroll 2 beats 1, 3 and 4 there.
CAST_UNROLL = 2
CAST_LOAD_POLICY = 2  # slc: nontemporal


def _flat_view(ptr, dtype, n_rows, width):
    t = fx.make_view(fx.recast_iter(dtype, ptr), fx.make_layout((n_rows, width), (width, 1)))
    return fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(t, max_size=False)


@functools.cache
def compile_cast(unroll: int):
    rows_per_block = CAST_THREADS * unroll
    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[CAST_THREADS, 1, 1])
    def cast_kernel(
        q: fx.Pointer, k: fx.Pointer, v: fx.Pointer,  # bf16
        qo: fx.Pointer, ko: fx.Pointer, vo: fx.Pointer,  # fp8 bytes, as i32 pairs
        nq: fx.Int32, nk: fx.Int32, nv: fx.Int32,  # 8-element rows
        bq: fx.Int32, bk: fx.Int32,  # blocks of q, of q and k
    ):  # fmt: skip
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bx = fx.block_idx.x
        reg_in = fx.make_layout(CAST_VEC, 1)
        reg_out = fx.make_layout(2, 1)
        atom_in = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(CAST_LOAD_POLICY), fx.BFloat16)
        atom_out = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy64b(), fx.Int32)

        def body(src, dst, n, b):
            g_in = _flat_view(src, fx.BFloat16, n, CAST_VEC)
            g_out = _flat_view(dst, fx.Int32, n, 2)
            row0 = b * fx.Int32(rows_per_block) + tid
            vals = []
            for u in fx.range_constexpr(unroll):
                row = row0 + fx.Int32(u * CAST_THREADS)
                frag = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_in, fx.BFloat16)
                fx.copy_atom_call(atom_in, fx.slice(g_in, (row, None)), frag)
                vals.append(frag.load())
            for u in fx.range_constexpr(unroll):
                row = row0 + fx.Int32(u * CAST_THREADS)
                x = vals[u]
                f = [x[i].to(fx.Float32) for i in fx.range_constexpr(CAST_VEC)]
                words = []
                for w in fx.range_constexpr(2):
                    lo = fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, f[4 * w].ir_value(), f[4 * w + 1].ir_value(),
                                                  fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), False)
                    hi = fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, f[4 * w + 2].ir_value(), f[4 * w + 3].ir_value(),
                                                  lo, True)
                    words.append(fx.Int32(hi))
                res = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_out, fx.Int32)
                res.store(fx.Vector.from_elements(words, dtype=fx.Int32))
                fx.copy_atom_call(atom_out, res, fx.slice(g_out, (row, None)))

        if bx < bq:
            body(q, qo, nq, bx)
        elif bx < bk:
            body(k, ko, nk, bx - bq)
        else:
            body(v, vo, nv, bx - bk)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        q: fx.Pointer, k: fx.Pointer, v: fx.Pointer,
        qo: fx.Pointer, ko: fx.Pointer, vo: fx.Pointer,
        nq: fx.Int32, nk: fx.Int32, nv: fx.Int32,
        bq: fx.Int32, bk: fx.Int32, n_blocks: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream = fx.Stream(None),
    ):  # fmt: skip
        assert unroll >= 1  # the unroll is a closure int the launcher reads, so it is part of the cache key
        cast_kernel(q, k, v, qo, ko, vo, nq, nk, nv, bq, bk).launch(
            grid=(n_blocks, 1, 1), block=(CAST_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch


# CAST_VEC-wide rows one launch converts of each tensor: their byte offsets stay within int32 (2**26 rows are 1 GiB
# of bf16)
CAST_MAX_ROWS = 1 << 26


def cast_fp8(q, k, v, qf, kf, vf, unroll: int):
    """q, k, v (contiguous bf16) -> qf, kf, vf (contiguous fp8 e4m3fn) in one launch, one per CAST_MAX_ROWS rows of
    the largest past that."""
    counts = [x.numel() // CAST_VEC for x in (q, k, v)]
    rows = CAST_THREADS * unroll
    cb = lambda n: (n + rows - 1) // rows  # noqa: E731
    stream = fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(q.device))
    for r0 in range(0, max(counts), CAST_MAX_ROWS):
        nq, nk, nv = (min(max(n - r0, 0), CAST_MAX_ROWS) for n in counts)
        bq, bk, bv = cb(nq), cb(nk), cb(nv)
        src = [x.data_ptr() + r0 * CAST_VEC * 2 for x in (q, k, v)]
        dst = [x.data_ptr() + r0 * CAST_VEC for x in (qf, kf, vf)]
        compile_cast(unroll)(
            *(flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, p) for p in src), *(flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Int32, p) for p in dst),
            nq, nk, nv, bq, bq + bk, bq + bk + bv, stream,
        )  # fmt: skip


def _d1a(work_indptr, work_info):
    """Permute aiter's whole CU lists so each 3-head cluster sits on two XCDs (WG w runs on XCD w % 8)."""
    wi = work_indptr.tolist()
    info = work_info.view(-1, 8).tolist()
    n = len(wi) - 1
    clusters = {}
    for l in range(n):
        cs = {(info[w][7] & 0xFFFF) // 3 for w in range(wi[l], wi[l + 1])}
        if len(cs) != 1:
            return work_indptr, work_info
        clusters.setdefault(cs.pop(), []).append(l)
    if n != N_CU or len(clusters) != 4 or any(len(v) != 64 for v in clusters.values()):
        return work_indptr, work_info
    new = [None] * n
    for c, ls in clusters.items():
        for i, l in enumerate(ls):
            new[(i // 2) * 8 + 2 * c + (i % 2)] = info[wi[l] : wi[l + 1]]
    indptr, flat = [0], []
    for lst in new:
        for it in lst:
            flat += it
        indptr.append(indptr[-1] + len(lst))
    rest = work_info.view(-1)[len(flat):].tolist()
    dev = work_info.device
    return (torch.tensor(indptr, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
            torch.tensor(flat + rest, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(work_info.shape))


# Most keys one ASM call reads: longer key ranges are cut into segments of this many, each its own call, and the
# reduce merges every segment's partials by their lse.
KV_SEGMENT = 65536
# query counts (n_q == n_kv, causal) that take fill_plan over lpt_plan, raced on cast + ASM + reduce
FILL_PLAN_N = frozenset((6144, 7680, 15360))
# query counts (n_q == n_kv, causal) that take partition_plan: whole tiles, 3 per CU, no split and no merge depth
PARTITION_PLAN_N = frozenset((16384,))
# query counts (n_q == n_kv, causal) that take pair_chain_plan: short tiles paired, long tiles chained, <= 2 works per CU
PAIR_CHAIN_N = frozenset((8480, 9397))
# plans kept per shape: a forward's layers share one, and serving sees new lengths without end
PLANS_KEPT = 512


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=PLANS_KEPT)
def _piece_plan(n_q: int, n_kv: int, causal: bool, device):
    """aiter's persistent plan with need_lse for n_q queries over n_kv keys (one sequence), its CU lists permuted,
    the piece's offsets, and per query tile (q_start, q_end, its partial rows in split order).

    The plan is built on the host and copied in stream order (aiter's own planner writes its device buffers with a
    synchronous hipMemcpy on the null stream, which does not order with the current torch stream)."""
    from .ps_plan import fill_plan, lpt_plan, pair_chain_plan, partition_plan, ps_plan

    if causal and n_q == n_kv:
        # the cost-model plans already place each 3-head cluster on its two XCDs
        plan = partition_plan(n_q, n_kv, N_HEADS, num_cus=N_CU, tile_q=TILE_Q) if n_q in PARTITION_PLAN_N else None
        if plan is None and n_q in PAIR_CHAIN_N:
            plan = pair_chain_plan(n_q, n_kv, N_HEADS, num_cus=N_CU, tile_q=TILE_Q)
        if plan is None and n_q in FILL_PLAN_N:
            plan = fill_plan(n_q, n_kv, N_HEADS, num_cus=N_CU, tile_q=TILE_Q)
        if plan is None:
            plan = lpt_plan(n_q, n_kv, N_HEADS, num_cus=N_CU, tile_q=TILE_Q)
        work_indptr, works, tiles, n_partial, _ = plan
        work_indptr = torch.tensor(work_indptr, dtype=torch.int32)
        work_info = torch.tensor(works, dtype=torch.int32)
    else:
        work_indptr, works, indptr, final, partial = ps_plan(
            [0, n_q], [0, n_kv], [n_kv], N_HEADS, num_cus=N_CU, qlen_granularity=TILE_Q, kvlen_granularity=128,
            block_size=1, is_causal=causal,
        )  # fmt: skip
        work_indptr, work_info = _d1a(
            torch.tensor(work_indptr, dtype=torch.int32), torch.tensor(works, dtype=torch.int32)
        )
        tiles = [(*final[t], partial[indptr[t] : indptr[t + 1]]) for t in range(len(final))]
        n_partial = max(r for _, _, rows in tiles for r in rows) + TILE_Q
    # one copy in stream order from pinned memory, without waiting on the device (host_plan.upload)
    work_indptr, work_info, offsets_q, offsets_k = upload(
        [work_indptr.numpy(), work_info.numpy(), np.array([0, n_q]), np.array([0, n_kv])], device
    )
    indices = _indices(device, n_kv)
    return work_indptr, work_info, offsets_q, offsets_k, indices, n_partial, tiles


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=PLANS_KEPT)
def _plan(n_q: int, n_kv: int, causal: bool, device):
    """The ASM calls over one sequence, none reading more than KV_SEGMENT keys, and the reduce over all of them.
    Without the causal mask every query reads key segments [s, s + KV_SEGMENT); with it, the n_kv - n_q prefix keys
    before the queries' own are read whole in such segments, and query block [j, j + KV_SEGMENT) reads its own keys'
    segments before it whole and its own causally."""
    pieces = []
    if causal:
        prefix = n_kv - n_q
        pieces = [(0, n_q, i, min(i + KV_SEGMENT, prefix), False) for i in range(0, prefix, KV_SEGMENT)]
        for j in range(0, n_q, KV_SEGMENT):
            q_end = min(j + KV_SEGMENT, n_q)
            pieces += [(j, q_end, prefix + i, prefix + i + KV_SEGMENT, False) for i in range(0, j, KV_SEGMENT)]
            pieces.append((j, q_end, prefix + j, prefix + q_end, True))
    else:
        pieces = [(0, n_q, i, min(i + KV_SEGMENT, n_kv), False) for i in range(0, n_kv, KV_SEGMENT)]
    calls, groups, base = [], {}, 0
    for q0, q1, k0, k1, piece_causal in pieces:
        work_indptr, work_info, offsets_q, offsets_k, indices, n_partial, tiles = _piece_plan(
            q1 - q0, k1 - k0, piece_causal, device
        )
        for q_start, q_end, rows in tiles:
            groups.setdefault((q0 + q_start, q0 + q_end), []).extend(base + r for r in rows)
        calls.append((q0, q1, k0, k1, piece_causal, work_indptr, work_info, offsets_q, offsets_k, indices, base,
                      n_partial))  # fmt: skip
        base += n_partial
    spans = sorted(groups)
    # every query row reduced exactly once
    assert spans[0][0] == 0 and spans[-1][1] == n_q and all(a[1] == b[0] for a, b in zip(spans, spans[1:]))
    counts = [len(groups[span]) for span in spans]
    # the deepest split up to a depth of host_plan.REDUCE_SPLITS (every one built at warm_up), a tile padding its
    # partials with its first at weight 0: the output is bit for bit the exact depth's
    max_splits, short = reduce_depth(max(counts), counts)
    desc = []
    for q_start, q_end in spans:
        ps = [r * N_HEADS for r in groups[(q_start, q_end)]]
        ps += [ps[0]] * (max_splits - len(ps))
        desc += [q_start * N_HEADS, (q_end - q_start) * N_HEADS, len(groups[(q_start, q_end)])] + ps
    (desc_t,) = upload([np.asarray(desc)], device)
    one = _shared(device)[1]
    row_groups = _row_groups(max_splits)
    n_blocks = (TILE_Q * N_HEADS) // (ROWS_PER_BLOCK * row_groups)
    launch = compile_reduce(max_splits, short, row_groups)
    return tuple(calls), one, base, desc_t, len(spans), launch, n_blocks



# keys every piece can index: a piece takes the first n_kv (one ASM call reads at most KV_SEGMENT, or a planned
# shape's whole key range)
_SHARED_KEYS = 1 << 18


@functools.cache
def _shared(device):
    """Per device: 0 .. _SHARED_KEYS - 1, and the 1.0 every ASM call takes as its scales."""
    return torch.arange(_SHARED_KEYS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device), torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)


def _indices(device, n_kv):
    return _shared(device)[0][:n_kv] if n_kv <= _SHARED_KEYS else torch.arange(n_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)


# deepest reduce warm_up builds: a deep merge holds its partials in scratch, and under a vLLM rank's few free GiB
# the deepest launches fail (HSA_STATUS_ERROR_OUT_OF_RESOURCES: depth 768 with 8 GiB free, 384 with 4); a plan
# deeper than this (keys past ~8 segments) builds its reduce when it first runs, as before warm_up
WARM_MAX_DEPTH = 128


def warm_up(device, max_depth=WARM_MAX_DEPTH):
    """Build every reduce a plan can ask for (``host_plan.reduce_variants``), each by one launch over one query row:
    no serving call compiles one. Returns how many it built."""
    variants = reduce_variants() if max_depth is None else reduce_variants(max_depth)
    for depth, short in variants:
        part = torch.zeros((N_HEADS, V_DIM), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        lse = torch.zeros((N_HEADS,), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        desc = torch.zeros((DESC_HEAD + depth,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        desc[1:3] = torch.tensor([N_HEADS, 1], dtype=torch.int32)
        out = torch.empty((N_HEADS, V_DIM), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
        out_lse = torch.empty((N_HEADS,), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        compile_reduce(depth, short, _row_groups(depth))(
            flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, part.data_ptr()), flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, lse.data_ptr()),
            flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Int32, desc.data_ptr()), flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, out.data_ptr()),
            flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, out_lse.data_ptr()), N_HEADS, N_HEADS, 1, 1,
            fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(device)),
        )  # fmt: skip
    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
    return len(variants)


# --- Fused small-n causal attention (one sequence, n_q == n_kv <= SMALL_N_MAX): one launch, one wave per 16-query
# block and head. q, k and v are rounded to e4m3 and back to bf16 in registers; S^T = K Q^T and O^T = V^T P^T on bf16
# 16x16x16 MFMAs (lane l, r = l % 16, g = l // 16: A[r][4g + v], B[r][4g + v], C[4g + v][r]), so the S^T accumulator
# is P^T's B operand as it stands. Lane group g sums the 8-dim chunks 4j + g (j < 6) of q . k. Online softmax in the exp2
# domain over every key block (blocks past the query's keys are masked); output and lse are written directly.
SMALL_N_MAX = 257
_SB = 16  # queries / keys per block
_SMALL_WAVES = 4  # waves per workgroup, each a stride-4 share of the key blocks, merged through LDS


def _rnd4(f):
    """4 fp32 -> e4m3fn -> 4 bf16 (exact back conversion)."""
    lo = fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, f[0].ir_value(), f[1].ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), False)
    w = fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, f[2].ir_value(), f[3].ir_value(), lo, True)
    one = fx.Float32(1.0).ir_value()
    a = fx.Vector(fx.rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp8(T.vec(2, T.bf16), w, one, False))
    b = fx.Vector(fx.rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp8(T.vec(2, T.bf16), w, one, True))
    return fx.Vector.from_elements([a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1]], dtype=fx.BFloat16).bitcast(fx.Int16)


def _cvt_qk(raw):
    """6 loaded vec8 bf16 chunks -> 12 e4m3-rounded bf16x4 MFMA operands."""
    ops = []
    for x in raw:
        f = [x[i].to(fx.Float32) for i in range(8)]
        ops.append(_rnd4(f[0:4]))
        ops.append(_rnd4(f[4:8]))
    return ops


def _fp8w(f):
    """4 fp32 -> one packed e4m3fn word (the word _rnd4 converts back)."""
    lo = fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, f[0].ir_value(), f[1].ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), False)
    return fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, f[2].ir_value(), f[3].ir_value(), lo, True)


def _cvt_qk8(raw):
    """6 loaded vec8 bf16 chunks -> 6 e4m3 x8 (i64) MFMA operands, converted straight from bf16 pairs."""
    ops = []
    one = fx.Float32(1.0).ir_value()
    for x in raw:
        ws = []
        for hlf in range(2):
            acc = fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Int16(0), fx.Int16(0)], dtype=fx.Int16).ir_value()
            for sel in range(2):
                pr = fx.Vector.from_elements([x[4 * hlf + 2 * sel], x[4 * hlf + 2 * sel + 1]], dtype=fx.BFloat16)
                acc = fx.rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_fp8_bf16(T.vec(2, T.i16), acc, pr.ir_value(), one, bool(sel))
            ws.append(fx.Vector(acc).bitcast(fx.Int32)[0])
        ops.append(fx.Vector.from_elements(ws, dtype=fx.Int32).bitcast(fx.Int64)[0].ir_value())
    return ops


def _attn_step(kb, kops, vraw, qops, qrow, last, g, scale2, m, lsum, o):
    """One 16-key block of online softmax for a 16-query block (traced inside the fused kernel's runtime if)."""
    neg_inf = fx.Float32(float("-inf"))
    zero = fx.Float32(0.0)
    z4 = fx.Vector.from_elements([zero, zero, zero, zero], dtype=fx.Float32)
    vops = [_rnd4([vraw[i][t].to(fx.Float32) for i in range(4)]) for t in range(V_DIM // 16)]
    s = z4
    if len(qops) == 6:  # fp8 QK: 6 16x16x32 e4m3 MFMAs, lane group g holding chunk 4j + g
        kops = _cvt_qk8(kops)
        for c in range(6):
            s = fx.Vector(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_fp8_fp8(T.vec(4, T.f32), [kops[c], qops[c], s, 0, 0, 0]))
    else:
        kops = _cvt_qk(kops)
        for c in range(12):
            s = fx.Vector(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x16bf16_1k(T.vec(4, T.f32), [kops[c], qops[c], s, 0, 0, 0]))
    sv = []
    for i in range(4):
        key = kb * fx.Int32(_SB) + g * fx.Int32(4) + fx.Int32(i)
        ok = (key <= qrow) & (key <= last)
        sv.append(ok.select(fx.Float32(s[i]) * scale2, neg_inf))
    mb = sv[0].maximumf(sv[1]).maximumf(sv[2]).maximumf(sv[3])
    mb = mb.maximumf(mb.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(16), fx.Int32(64)))
    mb = mb.maximumf(mb.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(32), fx.Int32(64)))
    m_new = m.maximumf(mb)
    m_use = (m_new > neg_inf).select(m_new, zero)
    alpha = fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.exp2(T.f32, (m - m_use).ir_value()))
    p = [fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.exp2(T.f32, (sv[i] - m_use).ir_value())) for i in range(4)]
    lsum = lsum * alpha + (p[0] + p[1]) + (p[2] + p[3])
    pb = fx.Vector.from_elements([p[i].to(fx.BFloat16) for i in range(4)], dtype=fx.BFloat16).bitcast(fx.Int16)
    o = list(o)
    for t in range(V_DIM // 16):
        ot = o[t]
        sc = fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Float32(ot[i]) * alpha for i in range(4)], dtype=fx.Float32)
        o[t] = fx.Vector(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x16bf16_1k(T.vec(4, T.f32), [vops[t], pb, sc, 0, 0, 0]))
    return (m_new, lsum, *o)


@functools.cache
def compile_small_attn(nblk: int, nw: int = _SMALL_WAVES, depth: int = 1, qk_fp8: bool = False):
    H = N_HEADS
    NW = nw
    NIT = (nblk + NW - 1) // NW
    NT = V_DIM // 16

    @fx.struct
    class SmallStorage:
        o: fx.Array[fx.Float32, NW * 64 * NT * 4, 16]
        ml: fx.Array[fx.Float32, NW * 64 * 4, 16]

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[64 * NW, 1, 1])
    def small_attn_kernel(
        q: fx.Pointer, k: fx.Pointer, v: fx.Pointer,  # bf16
        out: fx.Pointer, lse: fx.Pointer,  # bf16, f32
        n: fx.Int32, scale2: fx.Float32,
    ):  # fmt: skip
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        l = tid % fx.Int32(64)
        w = tid // fx.Int32(64)
        bi = fx.block_idx.x
        r = l % fx.Int32(16)
        g = l // fx.Int32(16)
        h = bi % fx.Int32(H)
        qblk = fx.Int32(nblk - 1) - bi // fx.Int32(H)
        nrows = n * fx.Int32(H)
        last = n - fx.Int32(1)
        g_q = _view(q, fx.BFloat16, (nrows, QK_DIM), (QK_DIM, 1))
        g_k = _view(k, fx.BFloat16, (nrows, QK_DIM), (QK_DIM, 1))
        g_v2 = _view(v, fx.BFloat16, (nrows, V_DIM), (V_DIM, 1))
        g_o = _view(out, fx.BFloat16, (nrows, V_DIM), (V_DIM, 1))
        r_lse = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(lse, nrows * fx.Int32(4)))
        lay8 = fx.make_layout(8, 1)
        lay4 = fx.make_layout(4, 1)
        atom8 = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(), fx.BFloat16)
        atom_o = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy64b(), fx.BFloat16)

        def load_qk_raw(gt, row):
            # chunk j * 4 + g: the four lane groups read 64 contiguous bytes of a row per load
            raw = []
            tiled = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(gt, (row * fx.Int32(H) + h, None)), lay8)
            for j in fx.range_constexpr(6):
                frag = fx.make_rmem_tensor(lay8, fx.BFloat16)
                fx.copy_atom_call(atom8, fx.slice(tiled, (None, fx.Int32(4 * j) + g)), frag)
                raw.append(frag.load())
            return raw

        def load_qk(gt, row):
            return _cvt_qk(load_qk_raw(gt, row))

        qrow = qblk * fx.Int32(_SB) + r
        qrow_c = (qrow > last).select(last, qrow)
        qraw = load_qk_raw(g_q, qrow_c)

        neg_inf = fx.Float32(float("-inf"))
        zero = fx.Float32(0.0)
        m = neg_inf
        lsum = zero
        z4 = fx.Vector.from_elements([zero, zero, zero, zero], dtype=fx.Float32)
        o = [z4 for _ in range(V_DIM // 16)]
        def load_kv(kb):
            kb = (kb > qblk).select(qblk, kb)  # a fully masked block is skipped: read a cached one instead
            krow = kb * fx.Int32(_SB) + r
            krow = (krow > last).select(last, krow)
            kops = load_qk_raw(g_k, krow)
            # V^T operand: lane holds V[key 16kb + 4g + i][dim 16t + r]
            # dim remap: row m of d-tile t is dim 8m + t, so lane r reads dims 8r .. 8r + 7 of a key in one load
            vraw = []
            for i in fx.range_constexpr(4):
                vr = kb * fx.Int32(_SB) + g * fx.Int32(4) + fx.Int32(i)
                vr = (vr > last).select(last, vr)
                vt = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(g_v2, (vr * fx.Int32(H) + h, None)), lay8)
                frag = fx.make_rmem_tensor(lay8, fx.BFloat16)
                fx.copy_atom_call(atom8, fx.slice(vt, (None, r)), frag)
                vraw.append(frag.load())
            return kops, vraw

        kbs = [w + fx.Int32(NW * it) for it in range(NIT)]
        # the first `depth` K/V blocks are in flight before Q is converted
        ring = [load_kv(kbs[i]) for i in range(min(depth, NIT))]
        qops = _cvt_qk8(qraw) if qk_fp8 else _cvt_qk(qraw)
        for it in fx.range_constexpr(NIT):
            kb = kbs[it]
            kops, vraw = ring.pop(0)
            if it + depth < NIT:
                ring.append(load_kv(kbs[it + depth]))
            o0, o1, o2, o3, o4, o5, o6, o7 = o
            if kb <= qblk:
                m, lsum, o0, o1, o2, o3, o4, o5, o6, o7 = _attn_step(
                    kb, kops, vraw, qops, qrow, last, g, scale2, m, lsum, [o0, o1, o2, o3, o4, o5, o6, o7])
            o = [o0, o1, o2, o3, o4, o5, o6, o7]

        lsum = lsum + lsum.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(16), fx.Int32(64))
        lsum = lsum + lsum.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(32), fx.Int32(64))
        # every wave's (m, l, O^T) to LDS; wave w merges d-tiles NT/NW * w .. in wave order
        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(SmallStorage).peek()
        s_o = lds.o.view(fx.make_layout((NW * 64 * NT, 4), (4, 1)))
        s_ml = lds.ml.view(fx.make_layout((NW * 64, 4), (4, 1)))
        cp4 = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy128b(), fx.Float32)
        slot = w * fx.Int32(64) + l
        # chunk c holds dims 32g + 4c .. 32g + 4c + 3 (o[t][v] is dim 32g + 8v + t)
        for c in fx.range_constexpr(NT):
            fr = fx.make_rmem_tensor(4, fx.Float32)
            fr.store(fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Float32(o[4 * (c % 2) + i][c // 2]) for i in range(4)],
                                             dtype=fx.Float32))
            fx.copy(cp4, fr, fx.slice(s_o, (slot * fx.Int32(NT) + fx.Int32(c), None)))
        fr = fx.make_rmem_tensor(4, fx.Float32)
        fr.store(fx.Vector.from_elements([m, lsum, zero, zero], dtype=fx.Float32))
        fx.copy(cp4, fr, fx.slice(s_ml, (slot, None)))
        gpu.barrier()
        mls = []
        for j in fx.range_constexpr(NW):
            fr = fx.make_rmem_tensor(4, fx.Float32)
            fx.copy(cp4, fx.slice(s_ml, (fx.Int32(j * 64) + l, None)), fr)
            mls.append(fr.load())
        mm = fx.Float32(mls[0][0])
        for j in fx.range_constexpr(1, NW):
            mm = mm.maximumf(fx.Float32(mls[j][0]))
        wts = [fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.exp2(T.f32, (fx.Float32(mls[j][0]) - mm).ir_value())) for j in range(NW)]
        lt = zero
        for j in fx.range_constexpr(NW):
            lt = lt + wts[j] * fx.Float32(mls[j][1])
        inv = fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.rcp(T.f32, lt.ir_value()))
        row_lse = (mm + fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.log(T.f32, lt.ir_value()))) * _LN2
        if qrow <= last:
            orow = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(g_o, (qrow * fx.Int32(H) + h, None)), lay4)
            for tt in fx.range_constexpr(NT // NW):
                t = w * fx.Int32(NT // NW) + fx.Int32(tt)
                acc = [zero, zero, zero, zero]
                for j in fx.range_constexpr(NW):
                    fr = fx.make_rmem_tensor(4, fx.Float32)
                    fx.copy(cp4, fx.slice(s_o, ((fx.Int32(j * 64) + l) * fx.Int32(NT) + t, None)), fr)
                    x = fr.load()
                    acc = [acc[i] + wts[j] * fx.Float32(x[i]) for i in range(4)]
                res = fx.make_rmem_tensor(lay4, fx.BFloat16)
                res.store(fx.Vector.from_elements([(acc[i] * inv).to(fx.BFloat16)
                                                   for i in fx.range_constexpr(4)], dtype=fx.BFloat16))
                fx.copy_atom_call(atom_o, res, fx.slice(orow, (None, fx.Int32(8) * g + t)))
            if (g == fx.Int32(0)) & (w == fx.Int32(0)):
                rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(
                    row_lse.ir_value(), r_lse, ((qrow * fx.Int32(H) + h) * fx.Int32(4)).ir_value(),
                    fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
                )

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        q: fx.Pointer, k: fx.Pointer, v: fx.Pointer, out: fx.Pointer, lse: fx.Pointer,
        n: fx.Int32, scale2: fx.Float32, n_blocks: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream = fx.Stream(None),
    ):  # fmt: skip
        small_attn_kernel(q, k, v, out, lse, n, scale2).launch(
            grid=(n_blocks, 1, 1), block=(64 * NW, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch


def _small_attn(q, k, v, output, lse, n, sm_scale):
    nblk = (n + _SB - 1) // _SB
    compile_small_attn(nblk, qk_fp8=nblk <= 17)(
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, q.data_ptr()), flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, k.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, v.data_ptr()), flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, output.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, lse.data_ptr()), n, sm_scale * _LOG2E, nblk * N_HEADS,
        fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(q.device)),
    )  # fmt: skip


def run(*, q, k, v, cu_seqlens_q, qkv_fp8, causal, cu_seqlens_k, sm_scale, output, lse):
    # one sequence (the workloads' sequence count), whose offsets the row counts fix
    n_q, n_kv = q.shape[0], k.shape[0]
    if (causal and qkv_fp8 and n_q == n_kv and 0 < n_q <= SMALL_N_MAX and cu_seqlens_q.shape[0] == 2
            and q.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and isinstance(sm_scale, float)
            and q.is_contiguous() and k.is_contiguous() and v.is_contiguous()
            and output.is_contiguous() and lse.is_contiguous()):
        _small_attn(q, k, v, output, lse, n_q, sm_scale)
        return
    from aiter import mla_prefill_ps_asm_fwd

    calls, one, n_partial, desc, n_tiles, launch, n_blocks = _plan(n_q, n_kv, causal, q.device)
    fp8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
    if q.is_contiguous() and k.is_contiguous() and v.is_contiguous():
        nq, nk = q.numel(), k.numel()
        buf = torch.empty(nq + nk + v.numel(), dtype=fp8, device=q.device)
        qf, kf, vf = buf[:nq].view(q.shape), buf[nq : nq + nk].view(k.shape), buf[nq + nk :].view(v.shape)
        cast_fp8(q, k, v, qf, kf, vf, CAST_UNROLL)
    else:
        qf, kf, vf = q.to(fp8), k.to(fp8), v.to(fp8)
    logits = torch.empty((n_partial, N_HEADS, V_DIM), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    part_lse = torch.empty((n_partial, N_HEADS), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    for q0, q1, k0, k1, piece_causal, work_indptr, work_info, offsets_q, offsets_kv, indices, base, rows in calls:
        mla_prefill_ps_asm_fwd(
            qf[q0:q1], kf[k0:k1], vf[k0:k1], offsets_q, offsets_kv, indices, work_indptr, work_info, q1 - q0,
            sm_scale, piece_causal, logits[base : base + rows], part_lse[base : base + rows], output[q0:q1],
            one, one, one,
        )  # fmt: skip
    launch(
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, logits.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, part_lse.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Int32, desc.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.BFloat16, output.data_ptr()),
        flyc.from_c_void_p(fx.Float32, lse.data_ptr()),
        n_partial * N_HEADS,
        n_q * N_HEADS,
        n_tiles,
        n_blocks,
        fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(output.device)),
    )

"""aiter's persistent plan for its fp8 MLA prefill as ``get_ps_metadata_v1(..., need_lse=True)`` builds it
(``csrc/kernels/mla/metadata/v1_2_host.cuh``), in Python: every query tile, split over CUs or not, leaves fp32
partials with their log-sum-exp for the reduce. aiter's planner takes ``need_lse`` from 0.1.23 on; older ones (the
one in sglang 0.5.22's image) leave a tile one CU reads whole unreduced, so its lse is never written."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math


def _ceil_div(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """C's ``(a + b - 1) / b``, which truncates toward zero."""
    n = a + b - 1
    return n // b if n >= 0 else -(-n // b)


def ps_plan(
    qo_indptr: list[int],
    kv_indptr: list[int],
    kv_lens: list[int],
    num_heads_k: int,
    *,
    num_cus: int,
    qlen_granularity: int = 256,
    kvlen_granularity: int = 128,
    block_size: int = 1,
    is_causal: bool = True,
) -> tuple[list[int], list[list[int]], list[int], list[list[int]], list[int]]:
    """``(work_indptr, work_info, reduce_indptr, reduce_final_map, reduce_partial_map)`` as lists, as aiter's planner
    fills them with ``need_lse`` and one query head per key head (only its used rows: ``num_cus + 1``, one
    ``[batch, partial_qo_loc, qo_start, qo_end, kv_start, kv_end, kv_offset, q_head_range]`` per work, one entry per
    query tile), for sequences at ``qo_indptr``'s query rows over ``kv_indptr``'s key blocks, ``kv_lens`` keys each."""
    clusters = math.gcd(num_heads_k, num_cus)
    tgs = num_cus // clusters
    heads = num_heads_k // clusters
    per_unit = kvlen_granularity // block_size

    # each sequence's query tiles, head and tail alternately (0, n-1, 1, n-2, ...), with the key blocks they read
    tiles, units = [], 0
    for b in range(len(qo_indptr) - 1):
        qo_len, kv_len = qo_indptr[b + 1] - qo_indptr[b], kv_lens[b]
        ranges = [(s, min(s + qlen_granularity, qo_len)) for s in range(0, qo_len, qlen_granularity)]
        for i in range(len(ranges)):
            start, end = ranges[i // 2 if i % 2 == 0 else len(ranges) - 1 - i // 2]
            kv = min(kv_len - qo_len + end, kv_len) if is_causal else kv_len
            n = _ceil_div(kv, kvlen_granularity)
            tiles.append((b, start + qo_indptr[b], end + qo_indptr[b], n * per_unit, kv))
            units += n
    average, remainder = units // tgs, units % tgs

    work_indptr, works = [0] * (num_cus + 1), []
    for cluster in range(clusters):
        # each CU of the cluster takes its share of key blocks, the same for every head of the cluster
        tile = block = partial = 0
        for tg in range(tgs):
            for h in range(heads):
                head = cluster * heads + h
                head_range = ((head + 1) << 16) | (head & 0xFFFF)
                saved = (tile, block, partial)
                capacity = (average + 1 if tg < remainder else average) * per_unit
                while tile < len(tiles) and capacity > 0:
                    b, qo_start, qo_end, n_blocks, kv = tiles[tile]
                    kv_start = block + kv_indptr[b]
                    if kv - block * block_size <= capacity * block_size:
                        # the rest of the tile; reduced even when whole (need_lse), unless it reads nothing
                        consumed = n_blocks - block
                        loc = -1 if consumed == 0 else qlen_granularity * partial
                        partial += consumed != 0
                        kv_end = min(kv_start + consumed, kv_indptr[b + 1])
                        works.append([b, loc, qo_start, qo_end, kv_start, kv_end, 0, head_range])
                        tile, block = tile + 1, 0
                    else:
                        consumed = capacity
                        kv_end = min(kv_start + consumed, kv_indptr[b + 1])
                        kv_offset = kv_lens[b] - (kv_end - kv_indptr[b]) * block_size
                        works.append([b, qlen_granularity * partial, qo_start, qo_end, kv_start, kv_end, kv_offset, head_range])  # fmt: skip
                        partial += 1
                        block += consumed
                    capacity -= consumed
                if h != heads - 1:
                    tile, block, partial = saved
            work_indptr[cluster * tgs + tg + 1] = len(works)

    # one reduce per query tile, its partials in ascending order; every query row in exactly one
    groups: dict[tuple[int, int], set[int]] = {}
    for w in works:
        if w[1] != -1:
            groups.setdefault((w[2], w[3]), set()).add(w[1])
    reduce_indptr, final, partials, covered = [0], [], [], 0
    for start, end in sorted(groups):
        if start != covered:
            raise ValueError(
                f"query rows [{covered}, {start}) are in no reduce: their lse would be unwritten"
            )
        covered = end
        partials += sorted(groups[(start, end)])
        reduce_indptr.append(len(partials))
        final.append([start, end])
    if covered != qo_indptr[-1]:
        raise ValueError(
            f"query rows [{covered}, {qo_indptr[-1]}) are in no reduce: their lse would be unwritten"
        )
    return work_indptr, works, reduce_indptr, final, partials


# modeled keys a finer candidate plan must save over the even-cut search, and the most query tiles it is tried at
GUARD = 128
SMALL_T = 16


def lpt_plan(n_q: int, n_kv: int, n_heads: int = 12, *, num_cus: int = 256, tile_q: int = 256, c0: int = 448):
    """A cost-model plan for one causal sequence with n_q == n_kv: each query tile's keys are cut evenly (128-aligned,
    the same cuts for every head) into pieces of at most theta keys, and the pieces go longest first onto the
    least-loaded CU of their head's 3-head cluster (cluster c on the CUs w with (w % 8) // 2 == c, i.e. XCDs 2c and
    2c + 1), a CU's load counted as its keys plus c0 per work; theta minimises the predicted makespan.
    ``(work_indptr, works, tiles[(q_start, q_end, [partial rows in split order])], n_partial)``."""
    import heapq

    assert n_q == n_kv and n_heads % 4 == 0 and num_cus % 8 == 0
    hpc = n_heads // 4
    T = (n_q + tile_q - 1) // tile_q
    kvs = [min(((min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q) + 127) // 128) * 128, n_kv) for t in range(T)]
    n_cl = num_cus // 4

    def cuts(theta):
        out = []
        for k1 in kvs:
            n = max(1, min(-(-k1 // theta), k1 // 128))
            out.append([0] + [((k1 * j // n + 127) // 128) * 128 for j in range(1, n)] + [k1])
        return out

    def price(pieces):
        lens = sorted((b[j + 1] - b[j] for b in pieces for j in range(len(b) - 1)), reverse=True)
        heap = [(0, i) for i in range(n_cl)]
        for kv in lens:
            for _ in range(hpc):
                load, i = heap[0]
                heapq.heapreplace(heap, (load + kv + c0, i))
        return max(l for l, _ in heap), sum(len(b) - 1 for b in pieces)

    def cuts_lfirst(P):
        # each tile longer than P keys: a leftover piece first, then pieces of exactly P keys, the last keeping the
        # diagonal and any unaligned tail
        out = []
        for k1 in kvs:
            K = -(-k1 // 128) * 128
            if K <= P:
                out.append([0, k1])
                continue
            m = (K - 1) // P
            b = [K - j * P for j in range(m, 0, -1)]
            out.append(([0] if b[0] > 0 else []) + b + [k1])
        return out

    def valid(pcs):
        # no non-final piece reaches its tile's diagonal, every piece non-empty
        return all(c <= tile_q * t for t, b in enumerate(pcs) for c in b[1:-1]) and all(
            b[j + 1] > b[j] for b in pcs for j in range(len(b) - 1)
        )

    best = None
    # 512 at least: one tile of at most 383 keys would leave the range empty
    for theta in range(512, max(max(kvs), 384) + 129, 128):
        cand = (*price(cuts(theta)), theta)
        if best is None or cand < best:
            best = cand
    make = cuts
    # short sequences (at most SMALL_T query tiles) also try finer even cuts and cut-and-pair pieces, taken only
    # when they save at least GUARD modeled keys over the even-cut search
    if T <= SMALL_T:
        new = None
        for fam, thetas in ((cuts, (256, 384)), (cuts_lfirst, range(256, max(kvs) + 1, 128))):
            for th in thetas:
                p = fam(th)
                if valid(p):
                    cand = (*price(p), th)
                    if new is None or cand < new[0]:
                        new = (cand, fam)
        if new is not None and new[0][0] <= best[0] - GUARD:
            best, make = new
    theta = best[2]
    pieces = make(theta)
    loc_of, next_loc = [], 0
    for t in range(T):
        loc_of.append([next_loc + tile_q * j for j in range(len(pieces[t]) - 1)])
        next_loc += tile_q * (len(pieces[t]) - 1)
        # no non-final piece reaches the tile's diagonal
        assert all(c <= tile_q * t for c in pieces[t][1:-1])
    lists = [[] for _ in range(num_cus)]
    for c in range(4):
        heap = [(0, w) for w in range(num_cus) if (w % 8) // 2 == c]
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        items = []
        for h in range(hpc * c, hpc * c + hpc):
            for t in range(T):
                b = pieces[t]
                n = len(b) - 1
                for j in range(n):
                    items.append((b[j + 1] - b[j], h, t, j, b[j], b[j + 1], 0 if j == n - 1 else n_kv - b[j + 1]))
        items.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[2], x[1], x[3]))
        for it in items:
            load, w = heap[0]
            heapq.heapreplace(heap, (load + it[0] + c0, w))
            lists[w].append(it)
    works, indptr = [], [0]
    for w in range(num_cus):
        for kv, h, t, j, a0, a1, koff in lists[w]:
            works.append([0, loc_of[t][j], t * tile_q, min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q), a0, a1, koff, ((h + 1) << 16) | h])
        indptr.append(len(works))
    tiles = [(t * tile_q, min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q), loc_of[t]) for t in range(T)]
    return indptr, works, tiles, next_loc, theta


def fill_plan(n_q: int, n_kv: int, n_heads: int = 12, *, num_cus: int = 256, tile_q: int = 256, c0: int = 640):
    """A capacity plan for one causal sequence with n_q == n_kv: for the smallest CU capacity C (keys, plus c0 per work
    after a CU's first) that packs, each query tile reading more than C keys is cut once (128-aligned, the same cut for
    every head, never reaching the tile's diagonal) into a piece of C keys and the rest, and the pieces of each 3-head
    cluster are packed best fit, longest first, onto its CUs (w with (w % 8) // 2 == c). Same tuple as ``lpt_plan``
    (theta is C), or None when no capacity packs."""
    assert n_q == n_kv and n_heads % 4 == 0 and num_cus % 8 == 0
    hpc = n_heads // 4
    T = (n_q + tile_q - 1) // tile_q
    kvs = [min(((min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q) + 127) // 128) * 128, n_kv) for t in range(T)]
    n_cl = num_cus // 4

    def pack(cap):
        pieces = []
        for t, k1 in enumerate(kvs):
            if k1 <= cap:
                pieces.append([0, k1])
                continue
            a = min(cap, tile_q * t) // 128 * 128
            if a < 128 or k1 - a > cap:
                return None
            pieces.append([0, a, k1])
        items = []
        for t, b in enumerate(pieces):
            for j in range(len(b) - 1):
                for h in range(hpc):
                    items.append((b[j + 1] - b[j], t, h, j))
        items.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2], x[3]))
        loads, bins = [0] * n_cl, [[] for _ in range(n_cl)]
        for it in items:
            best = None
            for i in range(n_cl):
                nl = loads[i] + it[0] + (c0 if bins[i] else 0)
                if nl <= cap and (best is None or nl > best[0]):
                    best = (nl, i)
            if best is None:
                return None
            loads[best[1]] = best[0]
            bins[best[1]].append(it)
        return pieces, bins

    # from the balance bound up, 64 keys at a time
    lb = max(1024, -(-hpc * sum(kvs) // n_cl) // 64 * 64)
    for cap in range(lb, lb + 2 * max(kvs) + 129, 64):
        r = pack(cap)
        if r is not None:
            break
    else:
        return None
    pieces, bins = r
    loc_of, next_loc = [], 0
    for t in range(T):
        loc_of.append([next_loc + tile_q * j for j in range(len(pieces[t]) - 1)])
        next_loc += tile_q * (len(pieces[t]) - 1)
        # no non-final piece reaches the tile's diagonal
        assert all(c <= tile_q * t for c in pieces[t][1:-1])
    lists = [[] for _ in range(num_cus)]
    for c in range(4):
        cus = [w for w in range(num_cus) if (w % 8) // 2 == c]
        for i, w in enumerate(cus):
            for kv, t, hl, j in bins[i]:
                b = pieces[t]
                n = len(b) - 1
                lists[w].append((hpc * c + hl, t, j, b[j], b[j + 1], 0 if j == n - 1 else n_kv - b[j + 1]))
    works, indptr = [], [0]
    for w in range(num_cus):
        for h, t, j, a0, a1, koff in lists[w]:
            works.append([0, loc_of[t][j], t * tile_q, min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q), a0, a1, koff, ((h + 1) << 16) | h])
        indptr.append(len(works))
    tiles = [(t * tile_q, min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q), loc_of[t]) for t in range(T)]
    return indptr, works, tiles, next_loc, cap


def partition_plan(n_q: int, n_kv: int, n_heads: int = 12, *, num_cus: int = 256, tile_q: int = 256):
    """An exact plan for one causal sequence of full tiles with n_q == n_kv, as many tiles T as each 3-head cluster
    has CUs and T even: no tile is cut, and CU slot x (1..T, m = T / 2) of cluster c reads tile x for its first head,
    tile x + m (x <= m) or x - m for its second and tile 2m + 2 - 2x (x <= m) or 4m + 1 - 2x for its third, so every
    CU carries 3 whole tiles of 3m + 1 or 3m + 2 units of tile_q keys. Same tuple as ``lpt_plan`` (theta is the
    busiest CU's keys), or None when the shape does not fit."""
    if n_q != n_kv or n_heads % 4 or num_cus % 8 or n_q % tile_q:
        return None
    hpc = n_heads // 4
    T = n_q // tile_q
    n_cl = num_cus // 4
    if hpc != 3 or T != n_cl or T % 2:
        return None
    m = T // 2
    kvs = [(t + 1) * tile_q for t in range(T)]

    def s2(x):
        return x + m if x <= m else x - m

    def s3(x):
        return 2 * m + 2 - 2 * x if x <= m else 4 * m + 1 - 2 * x

    lists = [[] for _ in range(num_cus)]
    for c in range(4):
        cus = [w for w in range(num_cus) if (w % 8) // 2 == c]
        for x in range(1, T + 1):
            items = [(x - 1, hpc * c), (s2(x) - 1, hpc * c + 1), (s3(x) - 1, hpc * c + 2)]
            items.sort(key=lambda it: (-kvs[it[0]], it[0], it[1]))
            lists[cus[x - 1]] = items
    works, indptr = [], [0]
    for w in range(num_cus):
        for t, h in lists[w]:
            works.append([0, t * tile_q, t * tile_q, (t + 1) * tile_q, 0, kvs[t], 0, ((h + 1) << 16) | h])
        indptr.append(len(works))
    tiles = [(t * tile_q, (t + 1) * tile_q, [t * tile_q]) for t in range(T)]
    theta = max(sum(kvs[t] for t, _ in lst) for lst in lists)
    return indptr, works, tiles, T * tile_q, theta


def pair_chain_plan(n_q: int, n_kv: int, n_heads: int = 12, *, num_cus: int = 256, tile_q: int = 256, c0: int = 0,
                    piece_cost: int = 12):  # fmt: skip
    """A pair-and-chain plan for one causal sequence with n_q == n_kv: in each 3-head cluster the query tiles of at
    most P keys are paired (largest with the largest partner that fits in P) one pair per CU, and the longer tiles are
    laid end to end over the remaining CUs at capacity C, each CU taking the rest of one tile and the head of the next
    (cut 128-aligned, never reaching the tile's diagonal), so no CU has more than 2 works. Every tile has the same
    number of pieces in every head (the reduce's partial rows are per tile); the cuts may differ per head. P, C and the
    chain order minimise the busiest CU's keys plus c0 per extra work. Same tuple as ``lpt_plan`` (theta is the
    busiest CU's keys), or None when no candidate fits."""
    if n_q != n_kv or n_heads % 4 or num_cus % 8:
        return None
    hpc = n_heads // 4
    if hpc != 3:
        return None
    T = (n_q + tile_q - 1) // tile_q
    kvs = [min(((min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q) + 127) // 128) * 128, n_kv) for t in range(T)]
    n_cl = num_cus // 4
    total = hpc * sum(kvs)
    mean = -(-total // n_cl)

    def build(P, order, C):
        small = sorted(((kvs[t], t, h) for h in range(hpc) for t in range(T) if kvs[t] <= P), key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))
        used = [False] * len(small)
        bins, left = [], []
        for i, (k, t, h) in enumerate(small):
            if used[i]:
                continue
            used[i] = True
            if k == P:
                bins.append([(t, h, 0, k)])
                continue
            mate = None
            for j in range(i + 1, len(small)):
                if not used[j] and k + small[j][0] <= P:
                    mate = j
                    break
            if mate is None:
                left.append((t, h))
            else:
                used[mate] = True
                bins.append([(t, h, 0, k), (small[mate][1], small[mate][2], 0, small[mate][0])])
        longs = [(t, h) for t in range(T) for h in range(hpc) if kvs[t] > P]
        if order == 0:
            longs.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], x[0]))
        chain = left + longs
        R = n_cl - len(bins)
        if R < 0:
            return None
        ci, start = 0, 0
        for _ in range(R):
            if ci >= len(chain):
                break
            b, load = [], 0
            while ci < len(chain) and len(b) < 2:
                t, h = chain[ci]
                rem = kvs[t] - start
                if load + rem <= C:
                    b.append((t, h, start, kvs[t]))
                    load += rem
                    ci, start = ci + 1, 0
                    continue
                c = min((start + C - load) // 128 * 128, tile_q * t)
                if c - start >= 128:
                    b.append((t, h, start, c))
                    start = c
                break
            if not b:
                return None
            bins.append(b)
        if ci < len(chain):
            return None
        # piece counts per tile identical across heads
        cnt = {}
        for b in bins:
            for t, h, a0, a1 in b:
                cnt[(t, h)] = cnt.get((t, h), 0) + 1
        for t in range(T):
            if len({cnt.get((t, h), 0) for h in range(hpc)}) != 1:
                return None
        cost = max(sum(a1 - a0 for _, _, a0, a1 in b) + c0 * (len(b) - 1) for b in bins)
        cost += piece_cost * 4 * sum(cnt.values()) // num_cus
        return cost, bins

    best = None
    P = -(-mean // tile_q) * tile_q
    for P in range(P, P + 3 * tile_q, tile_q):
        for order in (0, 1):
            nb_lo = 0
            for C in range(-(-mean // 128) * 128, P + 1, 128):
                r = build(P, order, C)
                if r is not None:
                    if best is None or r[0] < best[0]:
                        best = r
                    break
    if best is None:
        return None
    bins = best[1]
    # split order per (tile, head): pieces by start
    pieces = {}
    for b in bins:
        for t, h, a0, a1 in b:
            pieces.setdefault((t, h), []).append(a0)
    loc_of, next_loc = [], 0
    for t in range(T):
        n = len(pieces[(t, 0)])
        loc_of.append([next_loc + tile_q * j for j in range(n)])
        next_loc += tile_q * n
    for key in pieces:
        pieces[key].sort()
    lists = [[] for _ in range(num_cus)]
    for c in range(4):
        cus = [w for w in range(num_cus) if (w % 8) // 2 == c]
        for i, b in enumerate(bins):
            items = []
            for t, h, a0, a1 in b:
                j = pieces[(t, h)].index(a0)
                final = a1 == kvs[t]
                assert a1 > a0 and (final or (a1 % 128 == 0 and a1 <= tile_q * t))
                items.append((a1 - a0, t, hpc * c + h, j, a0, a1, 0 if final else n_kv - a1))
            items.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))
            lists[cus[i]] = items
    works, indptr = [], [0]
    for w in range(num_cus):
        for kv, t, h, j, a0, a1, koff in lists[w]:
            works.append([0, loc_of[t][j], t * tile_q, min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q), a0, a1, koff, ((h + 1) << 16) | h])
        indptr.append(len(works))
    tiles = [(t * tile_q, min((t + 1) * tile_q, n_q), loc_of[t]) for t in range(T)]
    theta = max(sum(x[0] for x in lst) for lst in lists)
    return indptr, works, tiles, next_loc, theta
